title: The Orbit of the Deep
author: Orsen Zhou
blurb: Cyrus Okonkwo, a memory-smuggler running contraband past orbital customs, has spent twenty years hauling cargo through contested orbits. But when a ship returns from deep space with everyone aboard aged backward, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must deliver a message that will end the war — or start it before the jump window closes.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
